description:
AWS Athena adapter for the Culvert framework. Sprint-21 module (epic
        #144, T21.5, issue #149). Implements the Warehouse contract over AWS
        Athena (SDK v2): query/execute via StartQueryExecution + polling +
        paginated GetQueryResults, tableExists via GetTableMetadata, copy via
        CTAS, loadFromUri via a run-scoped external staging table. Also
        implements JobControlRepository as an append-only ledger (AD-2/AD-3):
        every state change is an INSERT INTO, reads project per run_id with the
        earliest terminal state winning. merge() and cleanupPartialLoad() are
        honestly unimplemented - Athena has no MERGE and no DELETE outside
        Iceberg-backed tables; both throw rather than degrade (see class
        Javadocs).
